৫. সরল করো:

ক) $\frac{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}}}{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}}}$

খ) $\frac{a^{\frac{3}{2}} + ab}{ab - b^{3}} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$

গ) $\frac{1}{1 + a^{-m}b^{n} + a^{-m}c^{p}} + \frac{1}{1 + b^{-n}c^{p} + b^{-n}a^{m}} + \frac{1}{1 + c^{-p}a^{m} + c^{-p}b^{n}}$

ঘ) $\sqrt[bc]{\frac{x^{\frac{c}{a}}}{x^{\frac{a}{b}}}} \times \sqrt[ca]{\frac{x^{\frac{a}{b}}}{x^{\frac{b}{c}}}} \times \sqrt[ab]{\frac{x^{\frac{b}{c}}}{x^{\frac{c}{a}}}}$

ঙ) $\frac{(a^{2} - b^{-2})^{a}(a - b^{-1})^{b-a}}{(b^{2} - a^{-2})^{b}(b + a^{-1})^{a-b}}$

৬. দেখাও যে,

ক) যদি $x = a^{q+r}b^{p}$, $y = a^{r+p}b^{q}$, $z = a^{p+q}b^{r}$ হয়, তবে $x^{q-r} \cdot y^{r-p} \cdot z^{p-q} = 1$

খ) যদি $a^{p} = b$, $b^{q} = c$ এবং $c^{r} = a$ হয়, তবে $pqr = 1$

গ) যদি $a^{x} = p$, $a^{y} = q$ এবং $a^{z} = (p^{y}q^{x})^{z}$ হয়, তবে $xyz = 1$
